geography: United States, nationwide -- all NTD-reporting agencies, by mode
time_coverage: annual, report years 1991 through 2024 (the long time series, not the 3-year window)
schema_and_format: CSV, ~409,700 data rows. One row per agency x mode x type-of-service x report year x measure, covering service supplied (vehicle revenue miles/hours, actual vs revenue, deadhead, days of service, average speed) and operating expenses. Complements the ntd-monthly-ridership-all-modes DEMAND panel with the SUPPLY and COST side over 30+ years. Distinct from the repo's existing forge/business/ntd/raw/metrics_dr.csv and service_dr.csv, which are the 2022-2024 window filtered to demand-response modes only.
update_frequency: annual (portal Update Frequency R/P1Y); a new report-year edition supersedes. source_checksum is null -- trust-on-first-use against an openly published federal table.
canonical_contract: none-yet -- aggregate agency-mode-year service and cost data. It is a covariate/benchmark source for Program E forecasting and for the deadhead work behind ADR-0039, not an instance of a canonical entity. themis.canonical.entities.DeadheadSegment is trip-level; this table's deadhead figures are annual rollups and cannot be lifted into it without fabrication.

quality_tests.name: header_has_agency_mode_and_year
quality_tests.description: first line carries agency, mode and report-year columns -- proves the export is the time-series table

quality_tests.name: spans_more_than_three_report_years
quality_tests.description: more than three distinct report years present, i.e. genuinely the long series rather than the 2022-2024 window already held

acceptance_threshold: downloads, is CSV, > 40 MB, > 300,000 data rows, and spans more than three report years.
retention_and_deletion: retain while the deadhead/economics work references it; cheaply reproducible from the portal so evictable ahead of audit and contractual records.
